description: This file implements an observability forwarding system in Go, which subscribes to various event buses, collects events, batches them, and forwards them to configured webhooks. It also handles retries, dead letter queue management, and periodic system state snapshots for observability purposes.

classes.name: ObservabilityWebhookStore
classes.description: Interface defining storage operations for observability webhook configuration and dead letter queue management.

classes.name: ObservabilityForwarder
classes.description: Interface defining the methods for an observability forwarder component.

classes.name: ObservabilityForwarderConfig
classes.description: Structure holding configuration parameters for the forwarder.

classes.name: observabilityForwarder
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the ObservabilityForwarder interface.

methods.name: NewObservabilityForwarder
methods.description: Factory function to create a new observability forwarder with provided storage and configuration.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the observability forwarder, subscribing to event buses and launching worker goroutines.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Gracefully stops the forwarder, cancelling ongoing operations and waiting for goroutines to exit.

methods.name: ReloadConfig
methods.description: Reloads webhook configuration from the store.

methods.name: GetStatus
methods.description: Returns current statistics and status of the forwarder.

methods.name: Redrive
methods.description: Attempts to resend all events in the dead letter queue to the webhook.

methods.name: subscribeExecutionEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to execution event bus and enqueues received events.

methods.name: subscribeNodeEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to node event bus and enqueues relevant events.

methods.name: subscribeReasonerEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to reasoner event bus and enqueues relevant events.

methods.name: publishSystemStateSnapshots
methods.description: Periodically queries agent system state and publishes snapshot events.

methods.name: publishSnapshot
methods.description: Builds and enqueues a snapshot event with current system state.

methods.name: enqueueEvent
methods.description: Adds an event to the internal queue, dropping if full.

methods.name: batchWorker
methods.description: Processes event batches, sending them and handling retries or DLQ fallback.

methods.name: sendBatch
methods.description: Sends a batch of events to the configured webhook URL with retry logic.

methods.name: doSend
methods.description: Performs the actual HTTP POST request to send events.

methods.name: computeBackoff
methods.description: Calculates exponential backoff duration based on attempt number.

methods.name: transformExecutionEvent
methods.description: Converts execution events into observability event format.

methods.name: transformNodeEvent
methods.description: Converts node events into observability event format.

methods.name: transformReasonerEvent
methods.description: Converts reasoner events into observability event format.

methods.name: generateObservabilitySignature
methods.description: Generates HMAC SHA256 signature for observability payload.
